clusters.name: plan07-context-serial
clusters.executionModeRationale: Each story's tests depend on types/exports introduced by the previous story (US-005 imports from US-001/002/003; US-008 depends on US-005's wiring). Splitting into parallel clusters would require synthetic dependency edges across nearly every pair. Total footprint ~10 hours sequential — orchestration overhead of parallelism outweighs the gain.
